message: Endpoint description for GET /indented contains "---" which will be interpreted as a YAML frontmatter delimiter by the docs renderer, causing parsing failures and 500 errors on the generated docs site. Remove the "---" delimiters from the description.

Endpoint description for GET /trailing contains "---" which will be interpreted as a YAML frontmatter delimiter by the docs renderer, causing parsing failures and 500 errors on the generated docs site. Remove the "---" delimiters from the description.
